name: patient_is_subject_with_health
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is a subject with health.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a subject with health.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not a subject with health.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is a subject with health.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is confirmed to be pregnant at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is confirmed not to be pregnant at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_lactating_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently lactating.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is confirmed to be lactating at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is confirmed not to be lactating at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current lactation status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_nutritional_supplement_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to any nutritional supplement (dietary supplement).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently exposed to any nutritional supplement (dietary supplement).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not exposed to any nutritional supplement (dietary supplement).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently exposed to any nutritional supplement (dietary supplement).

name: patient_is_exposed_to_nutritional_supplement_now@@other_than_study_interventions_calcium_phosphate_or_vitamin_d
meaning: Boolean indicating that the nutritional supplement exposure is to a substance other than the study interventions (calcium phosphate and/or vitamin D).
when_true: Set to true if the nutritional supplement exposure is to a substance other than the study interventions (calcium phosphate and/or vitamin D).
when_false: Set to false if the nutritional supplement exposure is only to the study interventions (calcium phosphate and/or vitamin D).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the nutritional supplement exposure is to a substance other than the study interventions (calcium phosphate and/or vitamin D).
